  "CRITERIA_MATCH_EXPLANATION": "This paper focuses on the development of a single online course for medical education in Africa, specifically addressing the need for standardized training in response to the COVID-19 pandemic. While it aims to improve medical education in Africa, it does not address regional curriculum harmonization initiatives involving multiple countries or institutions. The focus is on a single course, not a broader harmonization effort across different curricula or educational systems.",
  "Title": "Development of a free online COVID-19 training course for medical students in Africa",
